full_prompt_en: A square Romantic landscape painting shows a broad river valley at sunset, framed by dark vegetation and a warm gilded border. The upper sky opens around a low glowing sun near the center, with peach and mauve clouds spreading across a pale blue-gray atmosphere. Layered mountains and jagged cliffs rise behind the valley; their purple-brown silhouettes soften as they recede into luminous haze. On the left middle ground, a pale stone classical colonnade stands above the water among dense greenery. Its repeated columns catch golden light along their edges, giving the architecture a measured rhythm against the irregular rock forms. Tall palms rise on both sides, their narrow trunks and fanlike crowns drawing the view inward toward the sun. Below the distant ridges, a series of small pale falls descends through the valley toward a still river. The water bends across the middle and lower image, catching a bright band of reflected sunset near the far bank. Several small dark grazing animals stand on a lit grassy point close to the water at center-right, their scale making the surrounding landscape feel expansive. In the foreground, deep olive shrubs, rough earth, and dark leafy shapes form a shadowed ledge; their edges are richer and more detailed than the distant terrain. Soft oil-paint blending joins clouds and mist, while fine, controlled touches pick out foliage, architecture, and reflected light. The setting sun is the main light source, warming the upper stone, water, and exposed ground while the near corners remain in heavy shade. The overall composition uses a bright central opening, dark framing foliage, and receding warm-cool layers to give the scene a serene, idealized grandeur.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形浪漫主义风景油画呈现日落时分宽阔的河谷，深色植被与暖金色画框围住画面。上方天空围绕中央附近的低悬太阳敞开，桃色和淡紫褐色云层铺在浅蓝灰空气中。层叠山峦与锯齿状峭壁立于谷地后方，紫褐色剪影随着远去而融入发亮的薄雾。左侧中景，一座浅石色古典柱廊坐落在水面上方的密林之间。重复的立柱边缘接住金光，使建筑的规整节奏与不规则岩体形成对比。两侧都长有高棕榈，细窄树干与扇状树冠把视线引向太阳。远处山脊下方，数道浅色小瀑布穿过河谷，汇向平静的河道。水面横过画面中下部，在远岸附近接住一条明亮的日落反光。几只深色小动物在中央偏右的临水草地上低头觅食，它们的尺度使周围风景显得开阔。前景中，深橄榄色灌丛、粗糙地面和暗色叶片构成阴影覆盖的边缘；它们比远处地形更丰富、更清晰。柔和的油彩过渡连接云层与雾气，细致克制的笔触点出枝叶、建筑和水中反光。落日是主要光源，温暖上方石面、水面及露出的土地，近处角落则保持浓重阴影。整体构图以明亮的中央开口、深色框景叶丛和冷暖递远层次，赋予画面宁静而理想化的宏伟感。
style_prompt_en: The image has the finish of a carefully blended Romantic oil painting, with deep tonal framing around a luminous central distance. Warm gold and peach spread through a cool blue-gray and muted violet atmosphere, while olive-brown shadow masses hold the lower edges. Near forms receive small, controlled strokes and firmer silhouettes; distant forms dissolve into successive veils of haze. Broad soft transitions carry the light across large areas, and fine highlights pick out only selected ridges and surface textures. Repeated vertical accents and irregular clustered shapes set a measured rhythm around an open middle passage. Illumination appears low and warm, with bright reflection balanced against near-black foreground shade. The overall effect is expansive, idealized, and quietly theatrical, built from layered depth rather than hard graphic contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有精心晕接的浪漫主义油画质感，深色调框住中央发亮的远方。暖金与桃色散入冷蓝灰和柔紫色空气，橄榄褐色阴影块稳住下部边缘。近处形体有细小而克制的笔触与较坚实的剪影；远处形体则消融在一层层薄雾中。大面积柔和过渡承载光线，细亮点仅挑出少数棱线与表面肌理。重复的竖向强调与不规则聚集形体，在敞开的中部通道周围形成有节制的节奏。光照显得低斜而温暖，明亮反射与近黑的前景阴影相平衡。整体效果开阔、理想化且安静地富有戏剧性，纵深主要由层叠关系而非生硬图形反差构成。
theme_en: A sunset river valley with a classical colonnade and grazing animals
theme_zh: 有古典柱廊与临水动物的日落河谷
name: Robert Seldon Duncanson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
